name: OverSEA
tagline: Helps coast guards spot likely illegal fishing vessels across vast patrol zones.
problem: Overfishing threatens species and many industrial fishing vessels are not publicly tracked, while coast guards patrol huge zones with limited resources; the team cites research figures.
solution: An intelligence console that combines vessel data, maps and AI search to flag suspicious activity, with access control for sensitive data.
demo_moment: Team-described: open the console and see flagged vessels on a map with the reasons.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Grounds the problem in cited research on overfishing.

lessons: Citing sources in the pitch itself builds trust for an enforcement tool.
